description: Wedge of near-black glass with a cold blue sheen, cracked out of Rimeshard's rock. The edge never dulls.
lore: The edge never dulls, so nobody sharpens one, so a man who owns one has nothing to do with his hands of an evening and does it anyway.

[[characters/8c41be1e|Hearn]] carries a shard off a [[monsters/ice_crystal_golem|Rimeshard]] on the black rock, in a sleeve on his belt, and has not cut anything with it since he came back down the mountain on his own. After the fire is banked he takes it out, wipes it on his knee, holds it up, turns it, puts it away. Every night. Someone at his fire made a joke of it once. He waited for the laugh to finish and said it was not for the mountain, it was for the walk home, and did not say which walk.
